messages:
Rae (AE): Quick sync for Beacon POC — customer wants a 2-week pilot. Need to firm success criteria (latency/cost/quality), KMS/VPC asks, and who runs evals.
Kai (SE): Proposed: 1 week ramp + 1 week acceptance. Targets: p50 < 180ms (256 tokens), p95 < 420ms, error_rate <0.5%. Quality = >=90% on their 120-prompt suite. Cost target ~ $0.018 per 1k tokens.
Morgan (Customer): Sounds good. We'll run human labels on 120 prompts. p95 up to 500ms is acceptable for our UI. Pilot budget = $7.5k.
Anya (Security): They require customer-managed KMS, per-request audit logs, EU log residency (eu-west-1), and a completed security questionnaire.
Samir (Infra): For a short pilot we can do hosted with envelope encryption to their KMS and pin logs to eu-west-1. KMS binding ETA ~72h after we get ARN. VPC peering needs their infra contact and extra lead time.
Kai (SE): Eval plan: run 120-prompt suite + 1 day stress with burst simulation. A/B: 4-bit quant vs baseline. Acceptance rules: accuracy_pct >=90 AND hallucination_rate <=3% AND error_rate <=0.5%. If quantization drops quality >5% fallback to baseline model.
Rae (AE): Action items: Kai = eval harness + quick README; Samir = KMS steps and ETA; Anya = docs list for customer. I'll confirm budget with Morgan. Please drop artifacts here by EOD tomorrow.
Morgan (Customer): We'll send infra contact and questionnaire today. Thanks everyone.
